So the assembled cell is in a discharged state, with the sodium later plated in situ on the carbon/Al current collector during the initial charge. The cathode capacity assumed for the energy density is 335 mAh/g[3], with the stoichiometry taken as Na1.5FeS2; the energy density is based on the mass of the presodiated pyrite and the carbon nucleation layer.
